parse.title: Agony (Path)
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 20 - Shibuya + Dungeons!

Overview

Agony (Path) is a Secret Limited unit. He can only be obtained via completing Path Portal (guaranteed if you are the host).

Evolving

Agony (Path) can evolve into Agony (Divine) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Agony (Path)
x50 Ninja Scroll (Fire)
x50 Ninja Scroll (Water)
x50 Ninja Scroll (Wood)
x12 Star Fruit
x4 Star Fruit (Blue)
x4 Star Fruit (Red)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Agony (Divine)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 7500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
